lsm-tree vs RocksDB

Every engine runs the same workload in one process on one host, in the same rounds: one sample each per round, taking turns at going first, so load on the host slows every engine of a round alike and divides out of their ratio. Relative to RocksDB shows each engine's time over RocksDB's in the same round, the median over all rounds (below 1 is faster than RocksDB); time per operation shows each engine's median. The tooltip gives the 95% confidence interval of either. Both engines get the same block size, bloom filter, block cache and values, no WAL, and every lsm-tree protection RocksDB has no equivalent for is off. · single-engine trend →

No head-to-head results have been published yet.
